headline: Mexican hospitals are using AI to flag suspicious breast scans for remote specialist review.
score_reason: Real-world use in a public health system with specialist shortages, but a video report with no readable details or numbers.
importance_line: Women waiting for mammogram results in Mexico may get answers sooner where AI triage reaches scarce specialists, but the report gives no figures on accuracy or how many hospitals use it.
summary: Al Jazeera reports in a video from a Mexican hospital that AI is being used to flag suspicious breast scans for specialists to review remotely, as long waits and a shortage of specialists slow screening.
notes: Video with a two-sentence description only; no text version found on another outlet (Modern Ghana carried the same video, blocked here). Headline only.
